missed: The affiliation is printed 'MAPS Public Benefit Corporations' (plural), as the card's affiliations note already shows with '(s)'; trivial.

The retracted article was the published long-term follow-up of the phase 2 trials, on which the MAPP1 authors' reply relies for durability (reader 27's report on mitchell_2021b). With it retracted, the only mention of follow-up beyond 18 weeks among the sources read is the sponsor model's use of MPLONG data, known only through marseille_2025; the claims' 'no outcome after 18 weeks is reported' should be read with that in view.
